# fish completion for rtok
# Generated by Pyrlyn.CommandLine.Docs from the command model; do not edit.

set -g __rtok_paths 'agents' 'agents info' 'agents install' 'agents list' 'agents uninstall' 'agents update' 'agents usage' 'completions' 'config' 'config get' 'config init' 'config path' 'config set' 'config show' 'config validate' 'filter' 'hook' 'logs' 'logs export' 'logs watch' 'man' 'plugins' 'run'
set -g __rtok_values 'agents info|--config' 'agents install|--config' 'agents list|--config' 'agents uninstall|--config' 'agents update|--config' 'agents usage|--source' 'agents usage|--host' 'agents usage|--since' 'agents usage|--until' 'agents usage|--by' 'agents usage|--tz' 'agents usage|--config' 'config get|--config' 'config init|--config' 'config path|--config' 'config set|--config' 'config show|--config' 'config validate|--config' 'filter|--cmd' 'filter|--config' 'hook|--host' 'logs|--lines' 'logs|--config' 'logs export|--lines' 'logs export|--config' 'logs watch|--lines' 'logs watch|--config' 'man|--dir' 'run|--agent' 'run|--config'

function __rtok_path
    set -l tokens (commandline -opc)
    set -e tokens[1]
    set -l cmd ''
    set -l skip 0
    for word in $tokens
        set -l next (string trim -- "$cmd $word")
        if test $skip = 1
            set skip 0
        else if string match -q -- '-*' $word
            contains -- "$cmd|$word" $__rtok_values; and set skip 1
        else if contains -- $next $__rtok_paths
            set cmd $next
        end
    end
    echo $cmd
end

function __rtok_at
    set -l at (__rtok_path)
    test "$at" = "$argv[1]"
end

complete -c rtok -f
